```{r}
#This script is used to analyze corrected flow cytometry data of each monoculture in Experiment 1
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

df <- read_excel("FC_Am_corrected.xlsx")
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Time = str_extract(Tube_Name, "T\\d+"),
    Replicate = str_extract(Tube_Name, "AK\\d")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T24","T48"))
  )
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Medium = recode(
      Sample_ID,
      "C1" = "WC",
      "C2" = "-YE",
      "C3" = "CH",
      "C4" = "-YE+CH"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID, Time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cells =
      mean(corrected_Cell_size_EventsPer_μL_V_dil),

    sd_cells =
      sd(corrected_Cell_size_EventsPer_μL_V_dil),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_df <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    Medium = recode(
      Sample_ID,
      "C1" = "WC",
      "C2" = "-YE",
      "C3" = "CH",
      "C4" = "-YE+CH",
      "YCFAG" = "YCFAG"
    )
  )

OUTPUT_DIR = "FC_Am_Exp1"
```

```{r}
#Violin plot

n_rep <- df %>% distinct(Sample_ID, Time, Replicate) %>%
  count(Sample_ID, Time) %>% pull(n) %>% max()

cell_size_violin_AK <- ggplot(df,
       aes(x = Time,
           y = corrected_Cell_size_EventsPer_μL_V_dil,
           fill = Medium,
           color = Medium)) +

  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.4,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    scale = "width",
    color = NA
  ) +

  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +

  theme_classic(base_size = 20, base_family = "Arial") +

  labs(
    title = paste0("Am monoculture growth dynamics"),
    x = "Time (h)",
    y = expression(
      paste(
        "Cell counts (events ", mu, "L"^{-1}, ")"
      )
    ),
    fill = "Medium",
    color = "Medium"
  )

print(cell_size_violin_AK)

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "AK_cell_size_violin_plot.jpg"),
  plot = cell_size_violin_AK,
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)
```
